sentences.text: Page No.# 2/2 Shri D. P. Goswami, learned Addl. Public Prosecutor, Assam shall do the needful.
Shri Ahmed, the learned counsel for the petitioner prays for an interim order.
It is submitted that apart from the fact that the petitioner is not even named in the FIR, he is not even remotely connected with the allegations.
It is further submitted that the petitioner has been served with a notice under Section 41 A of the Cr.PC.

In view of the above, in the interim, it is provided that in the event of arrest of the above named petitioner in connection with the aforementioned police station case, he shall be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand) with one surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Authority.
The petitioner is directed to appear before the IO of the case on or before 01.11.2023 for recording his statement.
The petitioner is further directed to render full cooperation with the investigation of the case and not to indulge in any activities detrimental to the same.
